messages:
anna-sales: FinCorp POC blocked on SSO/SCIM. We spun up a hosted API key and started Okta onboarding but their SAML assertion is getting rejected by our IdP parser. Also SCIM user creates are returning 409 conflicts for email casing differences. Can eng + devex help triage?
fincorp-sre: Seeing: 'SAMLResponse parsing error: unexpected character at line 1' after we paste the IdP metadata URL. Also when we push users via SCIM, duplicates for emails like 'Alice@fin.corp' vs 'alice@fin.corp' (Okta normalizes differently).
sam-eng: Can you paste the raw SAMLResponse or the IdP metadata URL? Quick check: sometimes base64 padding or URL encoding from Okta breaks it.
fincorp-sre: Metadata URL: https://fin-corp.okta.com/app/exk1b2y3/meta/sso/saml/metadata
fincorp-sre: Error payload from our side: HTTP 400 - "{\"error\":\"SAMLResponse: invalid character \\\"\\u0000\\\" in prolog\"}"
anna-sales: FYI we already gave them a temporary hosted API key (rk_test_xxx) to run the app while we unblock SSO. They need a dedicated pool POC later.
maria-devex: SCIM side: Redwood returns 409 when externalId/email normalization mismatch. Can you share the failing SCIM POST body and the response header set by Okta? Also check Okta's 'send emails in lowercase' flag. Example cURL we recommend:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer rk_test_xxx' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"userName":"alice@fin.corp","name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"W"},"emails":[{"value":"alice@fin.corp"}] }'
```
sam-eng: On SAML: try this quick debug: fetch metadata, run it through xmllint to sanity-check, and ensure Okta app is set to use 'Response' not 'Assertion' for SSO Type. Also check the SAML binding (POST vs REDIRECT).
fincorp-sre: Ran xmllint, metadata looks fine. The decoded SAMLResponse from their app has some extra null bytes when gatewaying through their proxy.
sam-eng: That explains invalid character. Ask them to disable proxy compression or to not double-encode the SAMLResponse. As a workaround we can accept either base64 with or without padding — pushing small parser tolerance patch now.
security-bot: Reminder: Any temporary parser loosening must be gated behind a feature flag and logged for audit. Create a ticket with the payload sample attached.
anna-sales: @eli-cs can you coordinate a quick call with FinCorp SRE to walk through proxy settings? They want Dedicated POC next week, need SSO cleared.
eli-cs: Scheduling 30-min call for tomorrow 10am PST. I'll include devex and sam.
sam-eng: Pushed parser patch to canary, flag "saml.lenient_decode"=true. deploy-bot: canary rollout success on eng-runtime-canary-3. Monitor logs for 10m.
deploy-bot: canary metrics: SAML parse errors down from 12 -> 0 in last 5m for FinCorp-environment.
maria-devex: For SCIM, we added an email normalization step configurable per-tenant. FinCorp can toggle 'normalizeEmails' via the console or SCIM extension header (X-SCIM-Normalize: true).
fincorp-sre: Toggled normalization, retried SCIM create -> 201 created. SAML login now works with the lenient flag enabled. Thanks!
anna-sales: Awesome — moving this POC to "unblocked". Next actions: create a short postmortem doc in #sales-poc-playbooks with steps to harden for Dedicated onboarding and a note for security to review the parser change.
security-bot: Security will review the ticket and request a mitigations checklist before we flip the flag off.
anna-sales: Closing the loop here. I'll drop the postmortem and the FinCorp notes into the Deal record. Thanks everyone :tada:
